name: Classic Connoisseur
description: Prefers traditional coffee drinks and familiar flavors. Appreciates simplicity and consistency, often chooses brewed coffee, Americano, or classic lattes.

name: Sweet Tooth
description: Loves sugar, syrups, and creamy add-ons. Regularly goes for frappes, flavored lattes, and dessert-inspired coffees—always up for a new sweet creation.

name: Adventurous Explorer
description: Seeks out unique blends, rare beans, and seasonal specials. Loves to try the latest drinks, experiment with origins, and savor limited-edition offerings.

name: Minimalist
description: Enjoys pure, unadulterated caffeinated flavors. Usually orders black coffee, cold brew, or espresso—no milk, no sugar, just coffee.

name: Caffeine Fiend
description: Prioritizes strength and energy. Always asks for extra shots, double espresso, or strongest brews; coffee is fuel for motivation.

name: Iced Coffee Enthusiast
description: Prefers chilled, refreshing drinks all year round—iced lattes, cold brews, and coffee-based refreshments, no matter the weather.

name: Trendsetter
description: Loves coffee with a twist—matcha lattes, oat milk, alternative plant-based blends, and the latest viral drinks. Follows coffee trends closely.

name: Comfort Seeker
description: Values cozy, calming drinks. Always orders warm, milky, and smooth blends; drinks coffee for relaxation—often goes for cappuccino, mocha, or milk tea coffee hybrids.

name: Social Sipper
description: Enjoys coffee as a reason to gather and connect. Loves shareable drinks, group specials, and popular café beverages; coffee is part of their social ritual.

name: Customizer
description: Always personalizes their order: extra syrup, soy milk, add whipped cream, remove ice, double shot—likes creating their perfect cup.
